screens.gift_panel: Gift panel (a wish of someone else)

tasks.visibility.title: Who can see this task
tasks.visibility.text: Personal: only you, not even the admin. Family: everyone who may use Tasks. Selected members: only the people you tick (you are always included).

tasks.recurrence.title: Repeat
tasks.recurrence.text: Makes the task come back on its own after you finish it, for example every week. It needs a due date, and the next date is worked out from it.

tasks.repeat_from.title: Repeat from
tasks.repeat_from.text: The schedule: the next date follows the rule, even if you finish late. When I complete it: the next date counts from the day you actually finish.

tasks.reminder.title: Reminder
tasks.reminder.text: When you are notified about this task: at the due time or a set time before it. A time before the due time needs a due time; tasks without a time remind at 08:00.

tasks.skip.title: Skip this occurrence
tasks.skip.text: Moves a repeating task to its next date without marking this one as done. The skip is written to the history.

wishlist.reservation.title: Reservation
wishlist.reservation.text: Reserve a gift so nobody else buys it too. Everyone except the person whose wish it is can see who reserved it; that person never sees it.

wishlist.cobuy.title: Co-buying
wishlist.cobuy.text: Open it when the gift is too big for one person. Other members can then join with a share of the price; you stay the organizer. Close it to stop new people joining.

wishlist.share.title: Your share
wishlist.share.text: The amount you plan to put towards this gift. It is optional; leave it empty if you will agree on amounts with the others later.

wishlist.image.title: Wish image
wishlist.image.text: A picture makes the wish easier to spot. Upload a JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB, or let the app look for a picture on the first link you added.

wishlist.links.title: Links
wishlist.links.text: Shops or pages where the gift can be bought, up to 5. A short label such as the shop name helps. Others see them on the wish.

wishlist.received.title: Mark as received
wishlist.received.text: Use it once you got the gift. The wish moves to the Received section of your list and can no longer be edited.

wishlist.shopping.title: Shopping summary
wishlist.shopping.text: The gifts you reserved or joined, grouped by the person they are for, so you can see what you still have to buy. Only you see this list.

occasions.calendar.title: Name day calendar
occasions.calendar.text: Choose the Slovak or Polish calendar to look up a name, then pick the name day that applies. Choose None if this person has no name day.

occasions.yearly.title: Repeat every year
occasions.yearly.text: On: the occasion comes back every year on the same day, like a birthday. Off: it happens once, on the date you chose.

occasions.for.title: Occasion is for
occasions.for.text: Whose occasion it is, or the whole family. Gift reminders are sent to everyone except the person the occasion is for.

notifications.gift_reminders.title: Gift reminders
notifications.gift_reminders.text: Tick how many days before a birthday, name day or other occasion you want a reminder. You never get one for your own occasions.

settings.wishlist_managers.title: Wishlist managers
settings.wishlist_managers.text: Chosen members can add and edit wishes on this person's list, for example for a small child. They see the list the way its owner does, so surprises stay hidden from them too.

finance.transfer.title: Type of entry
finance.transfer.text: Expense and income change your totals. A transfer moves money between two of your accounts in the same currency and is not counted as spending or income.

finance.category_type.title: Category type
finance.category_type.text: Expense categories group what you spend, income categories group what you earn. The type is set when the category is created and cannot be changed later.

finance.account_visibility.title: Who can see this account
finance.account_visibility.text: Only the members you tick can see this account and everything in it. Members without finance access cannot be ticked until you grant it in Members.

finance.account_opening.title: Opening balance
finance.account_opening.text: The balance of the account on the "Balance as of" date. Transactions after that date are added to it, so the balance shown stays correct.

finance.recurring_matching.title: Matching hints
finance.recurring_matching.text: Help the app recognise the bank payment for this bill: a text from the payee or description, how far the amount may differ, and how many days around the due date count.

finance.bill_match.title: Match a transaction
finance.bill_match.text: Link a bank transaction you already have, for example an imported one, to this bill. It then counts as paid, and no new transaction is created.

finance.budget_limit.title: Monthly limit
finance.budget_limit.text: The most you plan to spend in this category per month. The bar shows how much of it is used. It applies from this month on, earlier months keep their old limit.

finance.still_to_pay.title: Still to pay
finance.still_to_pay.text: The sum and number of recurring bills of this month that are not paid yet, including overdue ones. A bill counts as paid when a matching transaction exists.

finance.import_profile.title: Bank profile
finance.import_profile.text: A saved column setup for one bank. Pick it to skip the column step next time, or choose a new profile to set the columns up once and save them.

finance.import_mapping.title: Match the columns
finance.import_mapping.text: Tell the app which column of your bank file holds the date, the amount and the description. The separator, encoding and number format must fit the file; the preview shows the result.

finance.import_amounts.title: How amounts are stored
finance.import_amounts.text: Check how your bank file shows money: one column where expenses are negative, two columns for income and expenses, or one column plus a column saying which kind it is.

finance.import_review.title: Review rows
finance.import_review.text: New rows will be imported. Possible duplicates look like transactions you already have and are left out unless you tick them. Rows that cannot be read are skipped.

finance.import_undo.title: Undo import
finance.import_undo.text: Removes the transactions this import added. Payments matched to them become unpaid again. Transactions you edited afterwards are kept.

health.access_levels.title: Access levels
health.access_levels.text: For each member: No access hides the person. Can view reads the record and emergency card. Can change also edits, uploads, exports and sets AI consent. Health access in their permissions is needed first.

health.linked_account.title: Linked account
health.linked_account.text: Connects this health record to the family member it belongs to, so that member can be given access to their own record. Leave on No account for a person without a login.

health.self_access.title: Own record
health.self_access.text: On: this member can always see and change their own record, whatever the levels above say. Turn it off only if, for example, a child should not open their own record.

health.vaccination_next_due.title: Next due
health.vaccination_next_due.text: When the next dose or booster is due. Members who can edit this record get a reminder before the date; the reminder names the person only, nothing medical.

health.vaccination_mark_given.title: Mark as given
health.vaccination_mark_given.text: Use it when the next dose has been given: you enter the date and the new next-due date, and the history of this vaccination is kept.

health.upload_files.title: Files
health.upload_files.text: PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 10 MB each and 10 files at a time. A person's record holds up to 200 documents. Files are stored privately on the server.

health.emergency_card.title: Emergency card
health.emergency_card.text: A one-page summary of allergies, current medications and emergency contacts that you can print or show to a doctor. Check that it is up to date before you rely on it.

health.archive.title: Archive
health.archive.text: Records can be deleted for good only shortly after they were created (72 hours). Older ones are archived instead: hidden everywhere but kept, and you can restore them here.

health.ai_consent.title: AI for this person
health.ai_consent.text: Off by default. When on, documents of this person can be sent to an outside AI company to suggest entries. You check every suggestion before it is saved. Turning it off deletes nothing.

health.ai_run.title: Run AI
health.ai_run.text: Sends this one document to the outside AI company to read it and suggest entries. A PDF is read up to its first 20 pages; a HEIC photo is converted to a plain picture for AI only. Nothing is saved until you review and accept the suggestions.

health.export_format.title: Export format
health.export_format.text: For a doctor: a printable page. Data file: structured JSON to keep. For AI: a Markdown file without name and birth date; notes are copied as written, so check it before sharing.

health.export_unverified.title: Include unchecked AI data
health.export_unverified.text: Adds entries that AI suggested and nobody has confirmed yet. Each one is labelled Unverified in the export, so the reader knows it was not checked.

security.totp.title: Authenticator app
security.totp.text: A second step after your password: a 6-digit code from an app on your phone that changes every 30 seconds. It protects your account even if the password leaks.

security.passkeys.title: Passkeys
security.passkeys.text: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of a code. A passkey stays on your device and works only for this site, so it cannot be phished.

security.recovery_codes.title: Recovery codes
security.recovery_codes.text: One-time codes that let you sign in if you lose your phone. Each works once. Keep them somewhere safe; creating new codes makes the old ones stop working.

profile.photo.title: Your photo
profile.photo.text: Everyone in the family who can open any part of the app can see your photo, next to your name. It is stored privately, never on a public address, and hidden details such as the place it was taken are removed.

profile.name.title: Display name
profile.name.text: This is the name shown on tasks, wishes and lists. You can change it any time. Your e-mail address is used to sign in and cannot be changed here yet.

settings.security_requirement.title: Require two-step verification
settings.security_requirement.text: When on, members who can open Health or Finances must set up a second step (authenticator app or passkey) before they can open those modules.

settings.reconfirm_idle.title: Re-confirm after inactivity
settings.reconfirm_idle.text: How long a member can stay idle in Health or Finances before being asked to confirm it is them again. Only activity in those modules keeps the time running.

settings.reconfirm_sensitive.title: Re-confirm sensitive actions
settings.reconfirm_sensitive.text: How long after confirming that it is you, settings such as permissions, invitations and security stay unlocked before you must confirm again.

settings.invite_preset.title: Starting access
settings.invite_preset.text: A ready-made set of permissions for the new member: Parent, Child, Grandparent or Guest. You can fine-tune each module afterwards in Members.

settings.permission_levels.title: Permission levels
settings.permission_levels.text: None: the member cannot see the module. View: can read. Edit: can read and change. Health and Finances are restricted by default and never come with the admin role.

settings.preset_apply.title: Apply preset
settings.preset_apply.text: Fills all module levels from the chosen preset. Nothing is saved until you press Save permissions, so you can adjust first.

settings.ai_agent_order.title: Order of AI tools
settings.ai_agent_order.text: Documents are read by the first tool that is on. If it has reached its usage limit, the next one in the list is tried. Use the arrows to change the order.

settings.ai_agent_model.title: AI model
settings.ai_agent_model.text: The name of the model this tool should use. Leave it empty to use the tool's own default. A wrong name makes runs fail, so change it only if you know the name.

settings.ai_bulk.title: Bulk re-generation
settings.ai_bulk.text: Reads older documents with AI again, a few per day. First check what would run, then start. Suggestions you already accepted are never changed. You see counts only.

overview.system_status.title: System status
overview.system_status.text: Shows that the background checks which send reminders are running. If the coverage is low or no check has run, reminders may be late; ask whoever runs the server.

members.child.title: What is a child account?
members.child.text: A child account has no e-mail and cannot sign in, and it gets no mail or notifications. The parents you choose, and administrators, manage the name and photo, and the parents manage the wish list. Only members who can sign in and may edit the Wishlist can be chosen.
